title: Make and Take
bodyHtml:
YOU’RE INVITED! The Guild of Harwich Artists invites you to a “Make and Take” event! The Guild will hold its monthly meeting at 1:00p.m., followed by the “Make and Take” event. Guild artists will be demonstrating a variety of media:

  • Oil
  • Watercolor
  • Pastel
  • Colored Pencil
  • Chinese Brush Painting
  • Collage

Tables will be set up for the individual artists and attendees will have the opportunity to sit down and try out whichever media they choose, or may want to try two or three. All materials will be provided. Whatever works of art you create, you take home with you! Sound like fun? Come and join us.

Harwich Community Center, 100 Oak Street, Harwich, MA 02645
